lines.t: Snow falls on the memories
I can’t let go, they follow me
Footsteps fading in the night
But Your voice pulls me toward the light
Cold hands, trembling in the dark
Lost all the pieces of my heart
But still You whisper in my soul
“Hold on, I’m never letting go”
And every shadow starts breaking
When Your love is awakening
I feel the gravity changing
Pulling me home again
You lift me up like a sunrise breaking
Through every fear I’ve been facing
I’m running back to Your arms again
You’re my shelter, my strength within
When the storm starts raging
Your light keeps saving
I’m found wherever You are
I’m found wherever You are
[Drop / Post-Chorus]
(Yeah)
Light in the storm—You pull me higher

Whoa-oh, I’m found where You are
